scope: Avatars of friends' sites shown on the Friends page (/friends/). Each file is a copy hosted on this site, never a hotlink, listed here before it is used.
processing: Cropped to a square only when the original is not square, resized to at most 128 × 128 without enlargement, then encoded as WebP.
rights: Each avatar belongs to the site owner or artist named in its entry, and is shown here with that site owner's agreement as part of a link exchange. The site's software license does not cover these images.
fields: path (file under public/), friend (id in src/core/data/friends.ts), site, sourceUrl (where the site owner published or sent the avatar), creator, permission (how the site owner agreed), generativeAiUsed (as stated by the source, never judged from style), sha256, dimensions, verifiedOn.
